title: Robust conditional dimension reduction for dissimilarity data
abstract: arXiv:2609.06284v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conditional dimension reduction (cDR) learns low-dimensional latent coordinates while accounting for observed covariates that represent known sources of variation in the data. Conditional Multidimensional Scaling (cMDS) is a cDR technique that works directly with dissimilarity data. Its standard squared-stress formulation, however, is sensitive to contaminated dissimilarity, since outliers can dominate the objective and distort the learned configuration. We proposed Robust Conditional Multidimensional Scaling (rcMDS) by replacing the squared-stress criterion with a Fair M-estimation objective. We developed a reweighted conditional SMACOF algorithm to optimize this objective. The proposed algorithm admits computationally tractable updates, and its stabilized objective values decrease monotonically and converge to a finite limit. translated_title: 针对相异性数据的鲁棒条件降维方法
translated_abstract: 条件降维（cDR）在学习低维潜在坐标的同时，考虑代表数据中已知变异来源的观测协变量。条件多维标度（cMDS）是一种直接处理相异性数据的条件降维技术。然而，其标准的平方应力公式对受污染的相异性数据较为敏感，因为异常值可能会主导目标函数并扭曲学习到的配置。我们通过用Fair M-估计目标替代平方应力准则，提出了鲁棒条件多维标度（rcMDS），并开发了一种重加权的条件SMACOF算法来优化该目标。所提出的算法具有计算上可行的更新方式，其稳定后的目标值单调递减并收敛到有限极限。在合成数据和真实数据上的实验表明，该方法在处理受污染数据时表现优异。
tldr: 本文提出鲁棒条件多维标度（rcMDS），通过用Fair M-估计目标替代平方应力准则，并设计重加权条件SMACOF算法进行优化，有效解决了异常值对相异性数据条件降维的干扰问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Robust Conditional Multidimensional Scaling (rcMDS), which replaces the squared-stress criterion with a Fair M-estimation objective and develops a reweighted conditional SMACOF algorithm, effectively mitigating the distortion caused by outliers in dissimilarity data for conditional dimension reduction.
